dct_title_s: TOA Shortwave Flux (Monthly, Clear-Sky), Terra and Aqua/CERES
dct_description_sm: The CERES TOA Shortwave Flux (Monthly, Clear-Sky) layer shows CERES-observed temporally interpolated and spatially gridded top-of-atmosphere (TOA) outgoing observed flux or radiance (W/m²) contained within the SYN1deg product, which is a primary input to the EBAF product. This layer is for the shortwave broadband channel (0.2-5 µm), under clear-sky conditions. CERES footprints (20 km nominal resolution) are classified as clear if they contain 99% of pixels identified as clear by the CERES-MODIS clear-sky mask.

The CERES TOA Shortwave Flux (Monthly, Clear-Sky) layer is available from the CERES instruments on the Terra and Aqua satellites. The sensor resolution is 1 degree, imagery resolution is 2 km, and the temporal resolution is monthly.

A monthly visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 2002-07-01 to 2021-07-01. Made from CERES and GEO-Enhanced TOA, Within-Atmosphere and Surface Fluxes, Clouds and Aerosols Monthly Terra-Aqua-NOAA20 Edition4B (CER_SYN1deg-Month_Terra-Aqua-NOAA20, version Edition4B, doi:10.5067/TERRA-AQUA-NOAA20/CERES/SYN1DEGMONTH_L3.004B).
